Imagine the Earth as a giant spinning ball. As it spins, it moves around the Sun. This movement is called a cycle. During this cycle, the Earth moves closer to the Sun in some parts and closer to the Sun in other parts. This movement causes the seasons to change.

When the Earth is closer to the Sun, it's summer in the hemisphere that is facing the Sun. This is why it's summer in the north hemisphere and winter in the south. When the Earth is farther away from the Sun, it's winter in the north hemisphere and summer in the south.

This movement also causes the seasons to change. During the summer, the Earth's equator is closer to the Sun, so it's warmer. During the winter, the equator is closer to the Sun, so it's cooler. This is why we have seasons.

4. Ask Questions: Use your list of questions to ask the interviewer.

5. Take Notes: Take notes during the interview. This can help you remember important details and show your attention to detail.
